messages:
maria: quick sync — can we schedule a short PR sweep for terminology + tone? I opened a rollup PR with a list of link fixes and SDK snippet updates. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (please review)

ken: +1. Can you paste the list here? I'll triage into smaller PRs if needed.

maria: list:
- glossary: replace "model serving" vs "inference" usages (we should prefer "inference" for endpoints and "serving" for infra contexts)
- tone: adopt 'direct but helpful' phrasing for error messages and examples (short imperative sentences, one-sentence guidance)
- SDK snippets: update Python snippet to use the new Client API (avoid legacy ApiClient pattern), and add migration note
- links: fix /docs/old-embed -> /docs/embeddings and update any broken internal anchors
- examples: add a small streaming JS sample using async iterators

samir: tagging the SDK owners @joan. For Python snippet, here's suggested block to include in the migration guide:
```
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate("Summarize the following text: ...")
print(resp.text)
```
This avoids the legacy ApiClient pattern and matches the new auth flow.

joan: looks good. Also suggest updating JS sample to use an async iterator so users see how to handle streaming tokens. I'll draft it.

docs-bot: Reminder: CODEOWNERS requires at least 2 reviewers for docs/* changes. Also flagging potential CI lint failures when large fenced blocks are added. :eyes:

maria: action items (short):
- @ken: split the rollup into 3 PRs by EOD (glossary, SDK snippets + migration guide, link fixes + small examples)
- @joan: add the JS streaming example + update existing JS snippet to follow async iterator pattern
- @samir: draft the migration guide section and include the Python snippet + a one-paragraph rationale for change
- @maria: update docs style guide with the 'direct but helpful' phrasing, add one good/bad example for tone, and add the glossary mappings (term -> preferred phrasing)

ken: got it, splitting now. assigning reviewers and adding labels: docs/terminology, docs/sdk, docs/links.

joan: I'll push the JS patch in ~2 hours and add a unit test that validates the snippet compiles (simple lint).

samir: I'll drop the migration draft in a new markdown under /docs/guides/migration-sdk.md and ping for review.

maria: thanks all — if anyone hits edge cases or has phrasing pushback, drop them here or DM me. Planning a quick sync tomorrow if anything is blocked. :thumbsup:
